bull.b: Maintenance results suggest VK2735 can preserve substantial weight loss with less frequent dosing, including up to 97% every-other-week and 90% monthly retention. That flexibility could support adherence and strengthen the candidate’s differentiation as development advances.

Full enrollment of two large Phase III VANQUISH studies marks a significant execution milestone and moves VK2735 toward pivotal readouts. Combined with Phase II weight-loss results, the program has a clearer path to testing efficacy at scale in obesity.

New equity and convertible proceeds provide substantial capital for continued VK2735 and VK3019 development and commercialization preparation. Combined with management’s stated runway into 2028, the funding supports execution through multiple clinical milestones.

bear.b: VKTX remains pre-revenue across the reported history, while TTM net loss reached $534.8M. Without product sales to offset costs, the company’s financial profile depends on advancing candidates successfully and securing future funding or transactions.

Operating and free cash flow have remained negative and worsened to $418.4M in TTM, showing that late-stage trial expansion is consuming cash rapidly. Continued outflows can reduce financial flexibility even with current funding and runway.

The September financing included new shares plus convertible notes, creating equity dilution and potential future share issuance. While it funds development, these securities can reduce existing holders’ ownership and add obligations through 2032.
